Container.Name: gosearx
Container.Overview:
gosearx — a privacy-respecting metasearch engine written in Go. Aggregates ~70 engines in parallel with scriptable Lua/JS/exec engines and plugins, a React frontend, optional AI answer synthesis (Ollama / OpenAI-compatible), first-class GitHub search, and an integrated finance feature with interactive charts.
Valkey/Redis is OPTIONAL and runs as a SEPARATE container. Point the VALKEY_URL variable at it (e.g. valkey://valkey:6379/1) to enable shared caching, the rate limiter, and stats. Leave it blank to use an in-memory cache.
Secrets (GitHub token, Brave API key, OpenAI key) are provided via environment variables — never baked into the image.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the gosearx web UI and API.

Config.Name: settings.yml (optional)
Config.Description: Optional custom settings.yml. Leave the host path empty to use the image's bundled defaults. If you map it, copy the repo's settings.yml first and edit it.

Config.Name: Custom plugins (optional)
Config.Description: Optional directory of your own plugins (.lua / .mjs / .sh / .py). They ADD to the built-ins. Exec plugins run with bash/python3 available in the image.

Config.Name: VALKEY_URL
Config.Description: URL of an EXTERNAL Valkey/Redis (e.g. valkey://valkey:6379/1 or redis://192.168.1.10:6379/1). Leave blank to use an in-memory cache. The host/container must be reachable from this container's network.

Config.Name: GITHUB_TOKEN
Config.Description: GitHub personal access token (read-only is enough). Gives 5000 req/hr and enables code search. Optional.

Config.Name: BRAVE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Brave Search API key (for the braveapi engine). Optional.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Only needed if you enable AI synthesis with an OpenAI-compatible provider in settings.yml. Leave blank for local Ollama or disabled AI.
